page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz with an x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by bottom-quartile results in stress-ng single-core, Geekbench single-core, and single-threaded gzip compression. However, the 32 dedicated physical cores compensate in parallel workloads, delivering average multi-core performance in stress-ng, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory bandwidth and database operations also perform in the average tier, making the instance stable for concurrent memory-intensive tasks.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.se1ne.8xlarge offers a high-density memory profile without the added expense of bundled local NVMe storage or GPU hardware. This makes it a qualitatively cost-effective option for workloads requiring large memory footprints but moderate CPU compute power. Recommended workloads include in-memory databases, caching layers like Redis, enterprise applications, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines that do not require high single-threaded performance.
